caseName: Rowland v. Equal Employment Opportunity Commission
caseNameFull: Rowland v. Equal Employment Opportunity Commission

opinions.text: C. A. 9th Cir. Motion of petitioner for leave to proceed in forma pauperis denied. Petitioner is allowed until March 12, 1985, within which to pay the docketing fee required by Rule 45(a) and to submit a petition in compliance with Rule 33 of the Rules of this Court.

opinions.author: Brennanmarshall
opinions.text:
Justice Brennan and Justice Marshall,

dissenting.

For the reasons expressed in Brown v. Herald Co., 464 U. S. 928 (1983), we would deny the petition for writ of certiorari *1206without reaching the merits of the motion to proceed in forma pauperis.
